runs.quote: Values may contain commas as thousands separators.
runs.why: The solver passed comma-containing value strings directly to Decimal without stripping commas, causing ConversionSyntax errors.

The solver likely collapsed consecutive spaces (e.g. split on whitespace runs) instead of splitting on single spaces, so the empty severity field between '50' and 'INFO' was lost and INFO was treated as the severity, excluding the entry.
